repos.name: twilio/twilio-node
repos.why: Largest qualifying npm repo with TypeScript 5.9: 777 TS files, mostly generated API types. Plain tsc 13 s on a GitHub Linux runner (4.4 s on an M4 Mac). Jest suite passes in about 40 s in CI.

repos.name: cheeriojs/cheerio
repos.why: Well-known library with a public API and clear docs. Plain tsc 2.2 s warm. Vitest passes in about 7 s; `npm test` also runs lint, which fails at this commit.

repos.name: nteract/semiotic
repos.why: Large TypeScript 6.0.3 library: 2,793 TS files, plain tsc about 18 s on a GitHub Linux runner. Ships its own AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md that tell agents to run `npm run typescript`. Its vitest suite takes over 3 minutes, so success is checked with tsc and the task checks only.

repos.name: WJDDesigns/Ultra-Card
repos.why: Home Assistant card in TypeScript 5.9 with declaration: true. Plain tsc about 19 s on a GitHub Linux runner. Qualified once run facts covered its declaration lookups (alpha.12). Success is checked with tsc and the task checks only.

repos.name: oldj/SwitchHosts
repos.why: Tauri desktop app with a TypeScript 6.0.3 renderer and declaration: true. Plain tsc about 13 s on a GitHub Linux runner. Qualified once run facts covered its checker lookups (alpha.12). Its vitest unit suite (`npm run test:unit`) passes in about 15 s.

repos.name: The-DevOps-Daily/devops-daily
repos.why: Single-package pnpm 10 project (Next.js content site) whose test script is `vitest run`. Its suite runs `npx tsx scripts/generate-devto-feed.ts`, which rewrites public/feed-devto.xml and writes an npm log during the run, so every recorded run is UNVERIFIED (inputs changed during execution). Kept as a case that must never skip.

repos.name: hodfords-solutions/nestjs-api-gateway
repos.why: Single-package pnpm 12 NestJS library whose test script is `vitest run` (18 spec files, about 4.5 s in the census, no subprocesses or file writes). Added to show pnpm test checks reused on Linux, where pnpm hard-links installed files to its store. Its lint script is `eslint` (about 7 s), recorded by the general recipe through Corepack's pnpm 12 executable and pnpm's launchers.

repos.name: aflsolutions/shadowgit-mcp
repos.why: Small npm MCP server in TypeScript whose lint script is `eslint .` (about 4 s) and qualifies for the general recipe in the census. Its test script builds with esbuild first, so only typecheck and lint are measured.

repos.name: Kludex/starlette
repos.why: Python, uv. mypy on the package (scripts/check), about 0.2 s warm and 5 s cold; the same result inside the sandbox in the October 2026 sandbox census on Linux and macOS.

repos.name: langgenius/graphon
repos.why: Python, uv, typechecked with ty (a native program). About 1.1 s; the same result inside the sandbox on Linux and macOS.

repos.name: anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python
repos.why: Python, pip-style install into .venv, mypy on src/ and scripts/; the same result inside the sandbox on Linux and macOS.
